chatgptPrompt:
Create a YouTube Shorts cover, 9:16 (1080x1920).
Subject: a single face-down playing card, plain and unmarked, standing in front of a tall column of small white digits that rises and fades off the top of the frame.
Composition: 9:16 vertical: the card in the lower middle, the digit column rising behind it; the big symbol sits in the upper third, clear of the bottom quarter and the right edge.
Lighting and treatment: the film's own look: a deep slate background (#171A1E) with faint graph-paper lines, a glossy blue mannequin figure with no face, soft cool key light and a magenta (#EB63FF) accent; clean, minimal, high contrast, stylised 3-D render.
Mood: disbelief and wonder.
Text: "52!" in heavy white condensed sans-serif, the "!" in magenta, placed upper middle. No other text.
Scientific accuracy: 52! is about 8 x 10^67, a 68-digit number; the chance that two shuffles in history ever matched is below 1 in 10^36; the digits are decorative, not the real number; it is a diagram, not a photograph.
Avoid: no arrows, circles, faces, realistic people, logos, watermarks, extra text, or anything that looks like a real photograph.
Style: premium, art-directed, minimal 3-D science illustration that matches a clean code-rendered animation; not photorealistic, not generic AI art.
